# Smart Recipe

> A personal recipe collection. Agents can list, read and add recipes through a REST API.

- API spec (OpenAPI 3.1): /api/v1/openapi.json
- Auth: send `Authorization: Bearer <API key>` (or `X-API-Key: <API key>`) on every request.
- Format: recipes are schema.org Recipe JSON-LD (https://schema.org/Recipe); errors are RFC 9457 problem details.

## Endpoints

- `GET /api/v1/recipes?q=&limit=&offset=`: list or search recipes (schema.org ItemList)
- `GET /api/v1/recipes/{id}`: one recipe with ingredients and instructions
- `POST /api/v1/recipes`: add a recipe; body is a schema.org Recipe with `name`, `recipeIngredient` and `recipeInstructions`
